description: This file is a test script for Git, specifically testing the behavior of 'git rev-parse' with various revision syntax options and scenarios, including parent commits, branch names, shorthand revisions, and error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev_output
methods.description: Compares the output of 'git rev-parse --verify' with expected value.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of numbers for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two values and reports if they differ.
